Xi rolls out red carpet for Trump - PLA marches, children cheer for POTUS' 1st visit in 9 years
world news
Published on May 14, 2026 09:40 am IST
Share Via
Copy Link
Xi Jinping rolls out the red carpet for Donald Trump at Beijing’s Great Hall of the People, with PLA honour guards and children waving Chinese and U.S. flags. Behind the grand symbolism, the Trump–Xi summit is billed as a make‑or‑break meeting that could reshape global warfare, trade and tech rivalries.
